title: Competitive spirit and ambition at Super Cup ATTP – SUMMER 2025
body_html:
Registration of players for the national table tennis tournament “Super Cup ATTP – SUMMER” (9–10 August 2025, Top Cup Academy – Chișinău) has been completed.

The organisers express their support for and confidence in the players who, time and again, show talent, perseverance and a genuine competitive spirit.

The ATTP leadership wishes all participants every success and encourages them to make full use of their skills, resources and sporting potential to achieve outstanding results at this prestigious tournament.

May optimism, ambition and the will to win be with them every step of the way and drive them to their best performances!
